address: QT Auckland, 4 Viaduct Harbour Avenue, Auckland Central, Auckland, 1010, New Zealand
bio: This lofty restaurant boasts a patio and bar, plus an open kitchen anchored by a striking pizza oven. On the menu, there are about 20 Mediterranean-inspired items crafted from locally sourced produce. Spectacle and drama make the signature beef tartare an unforgettable dish – mixed tableside, the ground grass-fed eye fillet is silky textured and perfectly seasoned. Served piping hot, the puff bread creates another not-to-be-missed moment.
